$:set -eu
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
gh run download 42573871895 --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --name codespace-mcp-expression-inventory --dir "$tmpdir"
python3 - "$tmpdir" <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,collections,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
items=list(root.rglob('manifest.json'))
print('manifest_files',len(items))
for file in items:
 data=json.loads(file.read_text())
 files=data['files']
 cnt=collections.Counter(x['status'] for x in files)
 print('manifest',file,'total',len(files),'statuses',dict(cnt))
 print('expressions_successful',sum(x.get('expression_count',0) for x in files))
 for r in files:
  if r['status']=='error': print('ERROR',json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False))
PY
